inputs.userGoal: Terraform-managed development Worker Key Vault with worker-only Key Vault Secrets User RBAC and zero Key Vault access for the Blazor web process.
subGoals: Security-first identity separation and no private certificate material in Terraform
insightsApplied: insight-existing-terraform-identity: retain GitHub OIDC deployment identity without data-plane access
insight-existing-web-identity: explicitly exclude the web principal from Key Vault RBAC
insight-existing-m365-worker-app: do not assume Exchange app identity equals Azure workload identity
insight-existing-state-foundation: retain backend and exclude certificate material from state
insight-existing-development-rg: reference the confirmed resource group rather than recreate it

properties.networkConnectivityGate: The local worker's stable public egress IPv4 CIDR must be supplied and verified before apply; all other public traffic remains denied.

reasoning.whyChosen: Provides a dedicated RBAC-isolated store reachable by the local worker through the public Azure endpoint while excluding web and Terraform data access.
reasoning.tradeoffs: Standard Key Vault incurs cost. Public network access increases exposure, so the firewall defaults to deny and requires one approved stable worker egress CIDR plus Azure RBAC.

resources.name: ra-placehub-worker-secrets-user-development

reasoning.whyChosen: Grants only secret read access to the separately approved worker workload identity at the dedicated vault scope.
reasoning.tradeoffs: The exact principal must be approved and available on the selected worker host; Terraform needs separately bootstrapped role-assignment write authority but no secret read.

resources.dependencyReasoning: The assignment scope is the new vault resource ID.

overallReasoning.summary: Add one dedicated development vault and one worker-only data-plane assignment while retaining every existing identity and resource.
overallReasoning.tradeoffs: Certificate import, worker identity bootstrap, exact public worker egress CIDR, certificate administrators, monitoring and cost-incurring apply are intentionally outside this draft. No private endpoint is invented.

plan.validation: Draft is additive and references existing resource group and identities. It cannot advance to Terraform generation until exact naming, worker principal, network connectivity and cost/apply gates are approved.
